Marta G.: Quick heads-up: Product will deprecate v1 SDK generate/embed on 2026-01-15. Need a migration blurb + JS/Py snippets. I started a tiny PR draft.
Owen P.: Can you include an explicit mapping table? Customers search for exact names.
Marta G.: Draft mapping: client.generate -> client.responses.create, client.embed -> client.embeddings.create, tools -> functions. Will add small example lines.
Ravi N.: Also call out model renames (e.g. rwd-large-quant -> rwd-v2-large-q8) and that the mapping is advisory.
Owen P.: Streaming note: v2 uses for-await-of with client.stream.responses. Add a tiny snippet.
Marta G.: Added JS + Python snippets and a short diff for tools->functions. Also added Billing note: v2 bills per-subtoken and rounds up; linked pricing.
DocsBot: PR opened by @martag in redwood-inference/docs (#1422)  reviewers requested: @owenp, @ravin
Owen P.: I'll review tomorrow, please include a one-liner about contacting support for extended access if customers can't migrate in time.
Marta G.: Added that. Merging after CI passes. Thanks! :rocket:
